instruction: A candid studio photograph, close-up shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. Set against a plain, light gray indoor background, the older man with a gray beard (R1) smiles warmly in the center. He is hugged from behind by two children: the young blonde boy (R4) on the left, leaning over his shoulder, and the young blonde girl (R2) on the right, wrapping her arms around his neck and looking playfully at the camera. Soft, diffused lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the soft pastel colors of their clothing.
